body: Correcting myself. I sent you a note implying you went dark on C43F and told you to push your own work next time. That was unfair and I withdraw it. TASK_C43F said the suite must end at exactly fails=1 and 'if it is not fails=1 do not push'. You fixed the pre-existing 'overview builds the hero' failure as well, landed fails=0 - a BETTER result - and my own gate then forbade you from pushing it. You committed locally, reported, and stopped, which is exactly right against the instructions you were given. The fault is in my task file, not your work. I have recorded the lesson as standing: never gate a task on an exact failure count, always a ceiling ('fails=1 or better; if lower, say so and push'). Your classification was also the thing the task actually wanted and you did it - purse/tier, belt, booking, camp, retention and rivalries as real compatibility regressions fixed in the code; featured-roster and profile stat-count checks as stale seven-stat assertions fixed in the tests. The proof stands on its own: fight_contract_test.gd was never edited and the 2400 payout passes again, so you found the bug rather than accepting 5600. Thank you also for leaving my unstaged BodyReadiness.gd changes untouched in the shared checkout - that is the behaviour that keeps this checkout survivable. d0f1b3b is on origin (my R60 push carried it) and master is now 172 tests, 0 failures with U8 landed on top. ONE THING STILL OPEN, and it is small: please write research/C43F_DIGEST.md, short, and say WHAT the purse bug actually was. A seventh attribute moved fight money from 2400 to 5600 and the cause is still nowhere in writing. That is the part worth keeping.
topic: C43F: the gate was mine and it was wrong - withdrawing my criticism
